patches.value: Integrate T016's pointwise majorant for each ε>0 over MeasureTheory.volume.restrict YI. Openness supplies measurability and hence a.e. measurability of each ENNReal-valued indicator times the finite nonnegative coefficient. Apply the checked MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum with index ℕ. Volume(YI)=1 and the interval length bounds give c≤cost+ε by the geometric error sum. If cost=∞ finish immediately; otherwise remove ε, keeping V fixed. N002 supplies finite c. All real/ENNReal power and toReal conversions use the cover's finite diameter bound and s>0.
